## Usage

Use JSON summary metrics and CSV comparison tables for quantitative reporting. Use the qualitative record index to inspect actual prompts, responses, correctness indicators, rewards, and lengths. Do not compare metrics across different datasets without explicitly identifying the dataset and split.
